data.gender_notes: Druthiya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Druthiya is a name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Drutha' which means 'Seeker' or 'Truthful'. This name is believed to have originated in Hindu mythology and is often given to children who are believed to possess the qualities of truthfulness and a strong desire for knowledge and understanding. The name Druthiya carries the meaning “Seeker, Truthful” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Druthiya usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker, truthful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
